Syed Muhammad Ahmad (Ahmad) — Game Developer · Game Programmer · Graphic Designer. I build immersive games and interactive worlds with Unity, Unreal Engine and real-time 3D. Location: Karachi, Pakistan. Open to game development internships, junior roles and collaborations.
Spoken languages: English, Urdu, Chinese (basic). Interests: Gameplay programming, Game AI, AR / VR, 3D modelling, Graphic design.

I'm an aspiring Game Developer and Programmer in the final year of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science & Information Technology, specialising in Gaming & Animation, at NED University of Engineering & Technology in Karachi. I have hands-on experience with Unity and Unreal Engine and I'm proficient in C, C++, C# and Python. I love building immersive games and interactive applications — from sci-fi shooters with time-manipulation mechanics to VR education experiences and AR games. I'm eager to apply my skills in gameplay programming, AI and software development to craft engaging, polished player experiences.

to apply my skills in gameplay programming, AI and software development to craft engaging, polished player experiences. I also work as a graphic designer with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, and model 3D assets in Blender.

Project "Chrono Rebellion" (2026, category: Game). Technologies: Unity, C#, HDRP, Shooter.
A third-person and first-person sci-fi shooter featuring time-manipulation mechanics and combat systems.
Implemented gameplay logic, HUD, player controls and interactive mechanics in Unity using the High Definition Render Pipeline.
This is a featured project.

Project "Behind the Smile" (2026, category: Game). Technologies: Unity, C#, Game Jam, Narrative.
A narrative-driven 3D game built in 48 hours at Global Game Jam 2026 around the theme “Masks”.
Collaborated with a team during Global Game Jam 2026. Implemented gameplay mechanics, player interactions, UI and core game systems.
This is a featured project.

Project "Paper Plane Dash" (2025, category: Game). Technologies: Unreal Engine 5, Blueprints, Endless Runner, Procedural.
A third-person endless runner with procedural level generation, lane switching and obstacle avoidance.
Developed Blueprint gameplay systems, HUD, scoring and player mechanics in Unreal Engine 5.
This is a featured project.

Project "Solar System Exploration (VR)" (2025, category: XR). Technologies: Unity, OpenXR, XR Interaction Toolkit, VR.
An immersive VR educational experience with teleportation and interactive planet exploration.
Integrated XR interactions, locomotion and world-space UI using Unity and OpenXR.
This is a featured project.

Project "Voxelcraft 3D" (2025, category: Game). Technologies: 3D, Voxel, Sandbox.
A voxel-based 3D sandbox game inspired by block-building games.
Gameplay footage of a voxel world with block placement and exploration.

Project "Pac-Man" (2024, category: Game). Technologies: C++, SFML, Game AI, Data Structures.
A 2D Pac-Man game with enemy AI, collision detection and scoring, built with C++ and SFML.
Applied graphs, QuadTrees and other data structures to optimise gameplay performance. Graphics use the Simple and Fast Multimedia Library (SFML).

Project "AR Memory Card Game" (2025, category: XR). Technologies: Unity, Vuforia, C#, AR.
A marker-based augmented reality memory game using the Vuforia Engine.
Implemented image-target recognition, matching mechanics, animations and a scoring system.

Project "AR Face Filter App" (2025, category: XR). Technologies: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Computer Vision.
A real-time AR face filter app built with Python, OpenCV and MediaPipe.
Tracks facial landmarks through a webcam and applies interactive filters such as neon glasses, face frames and eye-glow effects in real time.

Project "Interactive 3D Portfolio" (2026, category: Web). Technologies: Three.js, WebGPU, Blender, After Effects, RAG.
This website: a rainy cyberpunk alley rendered with WebGPU, a custom Blender avatar, an After Effects promo and a RAG chatbot.
Built on Three.js TSL with GPU rain collision, wet-ground reflections and post-processing. Includes a Gemini-powered RAG assistant with source citations and a secured contact form using Resend.
